provenance.source: ICAR - Indian Institute of Water Management (IIWM) & FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper No. 56
provenance.document: Crop Evapotranspiration: Guidelines for Computing Crop Water Requirements (FAO-56) & ICAR Irrigation Agronomy Standards

methodology.explanation: Crop Evapotranspiration (ETc in mm/day) equals Reference Evapotranspiration (ETo from Penman-Monteith / meteorological radiation & temperature) multiplied by the crop-specific growth coefficient (Kc).
methodology.net_irrigation_requirement: NIR = ETc - Pe (Effective Rainfall in mm)

cotton.irrigation_guidance: In Vertisols (Black soil), irrigate in alternate furrows to save 30% water without reducing seed-cotton yield. Withhold irrigation when 30-40% bolls have opened.

paddy.irrigation_guidance: Adopt Alternate Wetting and Drying (AWD) using a field water tube (pani pipe) after tillering. Re-irrigate to 5 cm depth when water level drops 15 cm below soil surface. Drain water completely 10-12 days before harvesting.

maize.irrigation_guidance: Ensure adequate moisture at tasseling and silking; water stress during pollination causes incomplete grain set and poor tip fill.

chickpea.irrigation_guidance: In residual moisture black soils, one life-saving irrigation at pod development stage increases yield by 35%. Avoid flood irrigation during active flowering to prevent vegetative flushes and flower drop.

Vertisol_Black_Soil.irrigation_trigger: Irrigate when 50% available water is depleted (around 28% volumetric soil moisture).

Alfisol_Red_Soil.irrigation_trigger: Irrigate when 50% available water is depleted (around 15% volumetric soil moisture). Higher frequency, lower volume required.
